cards.text: Zion, another name for Jerusalem (Isaiah 52:1), is pictured here as a woman, and the LORD is about to answer her. Heaven and earth were just told to shout for joy (Isaiah 49:13), but Zion's not shouting. She says, "The LORD has forsaken me; the Lord has forgotten me!"

cards.question: The LORD answers Zion with a question about a mother. What does He ask if a woman can forget?
The LORD says that even if a mother could forget her child, He still will not forget Zion.

cards.text: Then the LORD says He has inscribed Zion on the palms of His hands. Friend, I spent years in a junk drawer feeling forgotten, and nobody wrote me down on ANYTHING, not even a sticky note.

cards.question: Zion is inscribed on the palms of the LORD's hands, and her ___ are ever before Him.

cards.text: Zion's destroyers and wreckers are packing up and LEAVING. Friend, that's the one moving truck the whole street is happy to see.

cards.question: As Zion's destroyers depart, her ___ hurry back.

cards.text: Then the LORD tells her, "Lift up your eyes and look around." Zion said she'd been forgotten, and now there's a whole CROWD gathering and heading her way.

cards.question: The LORD says Zion will wear this crowd as jewelry. What does He say she will put them on like?
The LORD says Zion's ruined and desolate land will have more room than her people need.

cards.text: Those who devoured her will be far away, and the children of her bereavement will say, "This place is too small for us; make room for us to live here." Friend, that's the kind of complaint you WANT, when your place is so full of family nobody can find a seat.

cards.question: Zion will say in her heart that she was bereaved and barren, exiled and left all alone. What will she ask about all these children?

cards.text: Then this is what the Lord GOD says: "Behold, I will lift up My hand to the nations, and raise My banner to the peoples."

cards.question: The LORD lifts His hand to the nations and raises His banner. What will the nations do with Zion's sons and daughters?
The LORD says kings will be Zion's foster ___, and their queens her nursing ___.

cards.text: Those kings and queens will bow to her facedown and lick the dust at her feet. Friend, that's the whole board of directors FACEDOWN on the carpet in front of the intern's desk!

cards.question: The LORD says Zion will know that He is the LORD. What does He say about those who hope in Him?

answers.text: They will never be put to shame
They will never have to wait

cards.text: Then comes a question: "Can the plunder be snatched from the mighty, or the captives of a tyrant be delivered?" That's like trying to get your phone charger back from your boss, and friend, that charger is GONE.

cards.question: The LORD says even the captives of the mighty will be taken away from them.
The LORD says He will save Zion's children. Who does He say He will contend with?

cards.text: Then the LORD says He will make Zion's oppressors eat their own flesh, and they will be drunk on their own blood, as with wine.

cards.question: The LORD says only Zion will know that He is her Savior and Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.
